Working with **film-crew → seedance-25-director**, as the studio rule requires for any video prompt.

**Session check:** there is no `NOTES.md` here and this folder isn't a git repo, so I couldn't pull or read the session log. I didn't change any files, so there was nothing to commit.

**Assumptions** (non-interactive run, so I'm stating them instead of asking):
- One Seedance 2.5 call of 15 s with three shots and two hard cuts. Each cut falls at the start of a voice-over line (4.5 s and 9.5 s).
- No uploaded references, text only.
- The recorded voice-over is added in the edit, not uploaded to Seedance. If uploaded as @Audio, the model may treat it as a voice to speak. The child never moves her lips.
- The brand name and tagline go on as an edit overlay, not generated in the video. AI video tends to scramble letters, and Armenian letters most of all. The book pages and spines carry no readable text for the same reason.
- No director's style was requested, so I chose quiet, close realism. The grade follows the brand colours: black, white and graphite, with red (#D90429) only on a ribbon bookmark.

## Crew plan (short)

| Shot | Voice-over | Director: what the shot does | Camera / light | Cut out |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 · 0–4.5 s | "Every child has a question nobody answered." | **The question.** At night, a girl draws a "?" in the fog on a window. | Close-up, 85mm, three-quarter angle from inside the room, very slow push-in. Cool moonlight from the left, night city lights blurred outside. | Hard cut from cool to warm. The "?" in the fog matches the book in her hands. |
| 2 · 4.5–9.5 s | "We write the books that answer it — in Armenian." | **The answer.** Inside a blanket fort she turns a page and understands. | Medium close-up to close-up, 50mm, eye level, slow push-in. Warm flashlight light bouncing off the page. The red ribbon appears here. | Hard cut. Her hand and the ribbon book carry over into shot 3. |
| 3 · 9.5–15 s | "Maghakian Scripts. Books for ages zero to sixteen." | **The promise.** Her hand puts the book on top of a stack that runs from a small board book to a thick novel. | 50mm at table height, locked off with a very slow push. Soft top light falling off to black. The top 40% of the frame is empty black for the overlay. | Ends on a 3-second hold for the logo. |

- **Look that stays the same in every shot:** a 7-year-old Armenian girl with dark curly hair and an oversized graphite knit sweater with cream cuffs.
- **Sound:** quiet natural sound only (a squeak on the glass, a page turn, a soft book landing), mixed under the voice-over. No music and no speech in the generated video.

## FINAL

**Settings (Dreamina):**
- Mode: Omni Reference
- Duration: 15 s
- Ratio: 9:16
- Resolution: 720p (1080p if your plan has it)
- Uploads: none
- Takes: 2–3, then pick the one where the girl stays most consistent across the cuts

**Prompt:**

```text
No uploaded references. Text-to-video, three shots separated by hard cuts.

Summary: A vertical 15-second film in quiet intimate realism: at night a 7-year-old Armenian girl draws a question mark on a fogged window, finds the answer in a picture book inside a blanket fort, and her hand places that book on top of a stack of children's books. Near-monochrome grade, deep blacks and soft whites, one deep crimson red accent.

Character (identical in every shot): a 7-year-old Armenian girl, dark brown curly shoulder-length hair, large dark brown eyes, light olive skin with faint freckles, retaining real fine pores and skin texture; oversized graphite-grey knit sweater with cream-white cuffs. Her lips stay closed the whole film; she never speaks.

[0-4.5s] Shot 1, close-up, 85mm lens, three-quarter angle from inside the room, very slow push-in. Night. The girl stands at a fogged window, cool blue moonlight from frame-left on her face, blurred warm city lights and a faint distant snow-capped double-peaked mountain outside. With her right index finger she slowly draws a large question mark in the condensation, lifts the finger away and stops, eyes fixed on the drawn question mark, brows slightly pulled together. Ends on the question mark in the fog with her eyes behind it. Sound: soft squeak of fingertip on wet glass, faint distant city hum.
➖ No text other than the single drawn question mark, no mirrored question mark, no other people.

[4.5-9.5s] Hard cut. Shot 2, medium close-up pushing slowly in to close-up, 50mm lens, eye level, facing her. Inside a small fort of white bedsheets, a small flashlight lies beside her and warm light bounces from the open page onto her face. She holds an open hardcover picture book; a thin deep crimson red ribbon bookmark hangs from it. The visible page shows a hand-painted illustration of a night sky full of stars; any printed text is soft out of focus and unreadable. She turns one page, stops, her brows lift, eyes widen, then a slow small closed-lip smile forms and holds. Ends on the warm close-up of her smiling face. Sound: one paper page turn, soft fabric rustle.
➖ No readable letters, no speaking, no lip movement, no adults.

[9.5-15s] Hard cut. Shot 3, camera at table height, slightly above, 50mm lens, locked off with a very slow push-in. A matte graphite table in a black void, single soft overhead light falling off to black at the edges. In the lower half of the frame stands a neat stack of children's books in plain matte covers of white, black and graphite cloth, growing in thickness from bottom to top: a small square board book, picture books, and thick novels. Her hand in the graphite sweater with cream cuff enters from frame-bottom, places the same hardcover with the crimson ribbon on top of the stack, and withdraws out of frame by 12s. From 12s to 15s the frame holds still: the stack, the hanging red ribbon, and empty black space filling the upper 40 percent of the frame. Sound: soft thud of the book landing, then near silence.
➖ No titles, no letters or logos on covers or spines, no on-screen text.

Global: vertical framing with the subject inside the central safe area; same girl, same sweater, same crimson ribbon throughout; near-monochrome low-saturation grade with deep blacks, warm skin tones only in shot 2, deep crimson red as the only saturated colour; fine film grain, natural motion, no slow motion. Pure video, no subtitles, no background music, no voice, no on-screen text, no logos, no readable writing anywhere, no other people.
```

**Edit (CapCut / Premiere / Remotion):**
- Put the recorded voice-over at 0.0 s. The cuts at 4.5 s and 9.5 s fall where lines 2 and 3 begin.
- Turn the generated sound down to about −18 dB under the voice-over.
- 9.5 s: fade the Maghakian Scripts logo, in white, into the empty black top area.
- 11.5 s: add the age line in white with a red #D90429 underline. Suggested text: «Գրքեր 0–16 տարեկանների համար». Check the wording against the voice-over text.
- Hold until 15 s.

**Timeline:**

| Time | Picture |
|---|---|
| 0–4.5 s | Question mark in the window fog |
| 4.5–9.5 s | The book, and her face as she understands |
| 9.5–15 s | The stack of books for 0–16, red ribbon, logo space |

**Risks:**
1. **Letters showing up on pages or spines.** If they appear, try another take or remove them with Edit with marks.
2. **The girl looking different in shot 2.** If this happens, first make a still of her with banana-pro-director-2.0. Upload it as @Image 1 and add this line at the top of the prompt: "Use @Image 1 as strict identity reference for the girl."
